sources.title: Qwen3.5-2B model card
sources.evidence: Exact post-trained checkpoint. The overview places nominal 2B under Language Model, documents a vision encoder, hybrid attention, native 262,144-token context, optional thinking, text/image/video usage and tool calling.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-2B configuration
sources.evidence: Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration has 24 text layers, alternating three linear-attention layers with one full-attention layer, dense intermediate_size 6144, tied embeddings, a vision configuration and max_position_embeddings 262144.

sources.title: Official checkpoint repository metadata
sources.evidence: Safetensors metadata reports 2,274,069,824 stored parameters: 2,274,067,232 BF16 plus 2,592 F32. Repository is public and ungated. This is checkpoint metadata, not the rounded language-model figure.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-2B Apache License
sources.evidence: Apache License 2.0 with Copyright 2026 Alibaba Cloud.

sources.title: Official Qwen repository release news
sources.evidence: News explicitly announces Qwen3.5-2B availability on Hugging Face and ModelScope on 2026-03-02. The former Qwen3.5 repository redirects here and retains its release chronology.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-2B checkpoint tensor index
sources.evidence: The checkpoint contains language-model, visual-encoder/merger and MTP tensors. Feed-forward tensors use gate/up/down projections; no expert tensor keys appear.

parameters_b.note: Full released checkpoint: 2,274,069,824 stored parameters / 1e9, including vision and MTP. Card nominal 2B is scoped to the language model, not this full tensor total.

active_parameters_b.note: No separate active-per-token count is published. Dense FFNs do not establish one count across text, vision and optional MTP execution.

architecture.note: Dense FFNs with hybrid Gated DeltaNet/full attention and a vision encoder. Generic family-level MoE highlights on the card do not describe this checkpoint.

modalities.note: Text generation with image and video input examples and corresponding configuration tokens.

reasoning.note: Thinking is supported but disabled by default for 2B.

tool_call.note: Exact 2B serving and Qwen-Agent examples document function/tool use.

description.value: Post-trained Qwen3.5 vision-language model with dense feed-forward layers, hybrid attention, optional thinking and tool calling.
description.note: Replaces unqualified speed language with documented architecture and capabilities.

patch.description: Post-trained Qwen3.5 vision-language model with dense feed-forward layers, hybrid attention, optional thinking and tool calling.
patch.notes: The card nominal 2B refers to the language model. Full checkpoint metadata reports 2.274069824B stored parameters, including vision and MTP tensors. Architecture is dense FFN with hybrid linear/full attention. Active parameters are not separately reported; no total-to-active equivalence is assumed. Thinking is optional and off by default. Release date is the official open-weight announcement.

summary: Correct total from nominal language-model 2B to full checkpoint 2.274069824B; establish dense architecture and replace unsupported speed wording. Confirm March 2 open-weight release, Apache-2.0, native context and modalities/capabilities. Separate active count remains undisclosed.
